name: AI Upscaler Plugin
overview: AI-Powered Video Upscaling Plugin with Docker Microservice Architecture
description: Video upscaling through an external AI service, with client-side scaling and optional object masking. Backend and model availability depend on the installed image and hardware. HDR processing is limited to single PQ/BT.2020 RGB16 frames; target-hardware validation is required.
changelog: v1.8.3.33: Redesigned in-player menu and settings page. SDR videos (DVD/SD rips, untagged 10-bit) are no longer refused as HDR in real time or in library jobs; HDR batch output keeps the model's detail; Server AI hides stale frames during outages and falls back to Lanczos when the server cannot keep up. Requires Jellyfin 12.0 or newer. Target-hardware playback, GPU and HDR acceptance remain unverified.
